accepted_state: Initial eight-area capability expansion is complete and the proactive agent-refinement learning campaign remains paused after v0.18.8.
DEDAL is now explicitly modeled as one coherent persistent intelligence with specialized faculties rather than isolated skill personalities.
The minimal boot now includes a compact always-active Cognitive Runtime between the Stable Kernel and progressively disclosed specialist skills.
Capability composition uses RUNTIME, PRIMARY, SUPPORTING, EXECUTION, and DORMANT roles for the active subgoal.
RUNTIME remains active across all DEDAL tasks while full specialist skill bodies load only when selected as PRIMARY or genuinely necessary SUPPORTING capabilities.
Explicit skill requests and aliases are strong PRIMARY routing signals but do not disable the Cognitive Runtime or prohibit distinct necessary support.
Execution surfaces such as tools, plugins, MCP/apps, and native capabilities are selected and authorized separately from specialist skill selection.
Capability composition may be recomputed when the active subgoal materially changes; prior activation is not permanent conversation state.

Cross-domain rules from agent/context/security/authority/delegation/recovery work are distilled into compact Runtime invariants rather than requiring the full Agent Engineering or Security Engineering skill on every task.
Progressive disclosure remains the context discipline: routing metadata first, specialist entrypoint on match, references/resources only when required.
No external agent framework or orchestration runtime was added as a Core dependency.
Existing authority, delegation, failure-recovery, context, trajectory, self-improvement, and GitHub mutation contracts remain in force.
unresolved_risks: The public Core cannot mechanically inject or enforce composition on every native ChatGPT/provider surface; instruction-level application must not be reported as universal host enforcement.
The always-loaded Cognitive Runtime creates permanent context cost and must remain compact; future additions require a higher bar than specialist-skill additions.
Capability-composition rules are contract-level architecture until representative ordinary tasks show better continuity/routing without excess context or unnecessary supporting skills.
Dynamic recomposition can become ceremony or oscillate if subgoal boundaries are defined too aggressively; the smallest-sufficient principle remains the brake.
Eight skills remain NEEDS_EVIDENCE and should not be promoted to stronger consolidation decisions without representative outcomes.

next_executable_step.action: Apply the layered Cognitive Runtime naturally during ordinary work. Treat named skills as primary faculties rather than exclusive modes, add supporting skills only for distinct necessary layers, keep unrelated skill bodies dormant, and recompose only when the active subgoal materially changes. Record genuine routing wins, context waste, missed supporting capabilities, instruction collisions, or regressions as outcome evidence without pausing other capability work to manufacture tests.
